title: Student V0.1 JOB 04 — controlled Wave 1 FAN-IN A
purpose: Combine the three exact qualified Wave 1 role deltas on one fresh integration branch, add only the minimum integration-owned build/source-manifest/CI routing needed for the combined candidate, and qualify the exact integrated head without silently repairing role semantics.
invariants: The accepted JOB 01, JOB 02 and JOB 03 heads are exact immutable inputs.
Child role deltas are applied from their shared Wave 1 base, not re-authored from memory.
No semantic conflict is silently repaired by the integrator.
v2 and v3 meanings remain unchanged; v4 contract remains frozen.
Lesson and flashcard completion remains non-scored and produces no mastery/validation evidence.
All scoring secrets remain behind the learner-safe presentation boundary.
UI does not own correctness; Learning/runtime does not own DOM mechanics.
Authoring/Factory changes do not alter learner runtime semantics.
Central workflow/build/source-manifest changes are minimal integration wiring only.
The generic role-branch CI router failure is not copied as product semantics; JOB 04 adds only the route needed for the integration branch/candidate.
requiredEvidence: Current main and all three accepted role heads are freshly re-read before integration.
Each role PR still points to the frozen exact head and remains unmerged.
Changed-path sets for JOB 01, JOB 02 and JOB 03 match the frozen input manifest and have empty pairwise intersections.
Every role-specific qualification test passes unchanged on the combined head.
End-to-end v4 tests cover qcm, fill, constructed, lesson, flashcard, matching, order, classify and bounded media.
Secret-boundary tests prove no correctChoiceId, answers, acceptedResponses, matches, correctOrder or classify assignments reach learner-safe presentation.
Lesson/flashcard completion creates no correctness, validation, mastery, transfer or spaced-review evidence.
Authoring v4 validator/quality outputs feed runtime admission and learner presentation without contract mutation.
v2 and v3 regression suites pass on the exact integrated head.
Repository governance, PR scope and the exact integration CI route pass on the exact candidate head.
The qualification artifact binds integration base, accepted child heads, result head, changed paths, tests and reservations.
adversarialTests: Any role-head drift or role-PR merge before integration fails closed.
Any changed child path not in the frozen manifest fails closed.
Any overlapping child writable path fails closed rather than being auto-resolved.
Any need to modify contracts or Wave 1 interface authority returns ARCHITECTURE_REOPEN_REQUIRED.
Any integration-only edit broader than build/source-manifest/CI/test/result wiring fails scope.
Any learner-visible scoring secret fails qualification.
Any lesson/flashcard mastery contamination fails qualification.
nonGoals: Improving child role implementations during integration.
Changing learnit.kit.v4 schema or architecture semantics.
Adding Knowledge-assisted authoring to the Student V0.1 critical path.
independentReview: JOB 01, JOB 02 and JOB 03 were qualified as separate role streams before integration.
JOB 04 must verify exact child heads and path independence rather than trusting reported chat state.
JOB 05 contradictory QA will independently attack the integrated candidate after FAN-IN A.
rollback: Close the FAN-IN A PR and delete its branch. The three role PRs remain open and independently recoverable; main remains at the coordination-only launch state.
